name: Touched by Fire rank 2 adds its bonus healing scaling (#2419)
contract: #2419: Touched by Fire 704848 (rank 1) is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107) on SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER (misc 24), base 14 -> +15; 704853 (rank 2) is the same slot as ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108), base 29 -> +30, class mask {0x42, 0, 0x100000} on both (Spell.dbc served file). Tooltip: gains an additional $s1% of bonus healing spell power. The Pyromancer heals carry a zero spell_bonus_data coefficient, and Player::ApplySpellMod skips PCT modifiers on a zero base, so rank 2 did nothing while rank 1's flat modifier worked. The module now makes rank 2 flat. spell_modifier applies the native modifiers for op 24 to a base of 0, which reads the coefficient the stock healing code would use: 15 for rank 1, 30 for rank 2 (0 before the fix). Cinderheart 800806 and 502044 have SpellFamilyFlags {2, 0, 0}, in the mask; Flare Bolt 800790 has {0, 2, 0}, outside it.

steps.label: No bonus healing scaling modifier on Cinderheart before the talent
Rank 1 adds 15% of bonus healing to Cinderheart
Rank 2 adds 30% of bonus healing to Cinderheart
Rank 2 adds 30% to a higher Cinderheart rank
